headline: Tesla made its Austin Robotaxi service run one hour later and added 111 Cybercabs to the fleet in two weeks.
score_reason: Concrete growth in a live driverless service; fleet counts rest on one outlet reading state records.
importance_line: Austin riders get longer service, but 24/7 operation is only a target and Tesla still has to solve night-time detection of animals.
source: Not a Tesla App, citing Tesla and Texas DMV data
summary: Not a Tesla App reports that Tesla has extended its Austin Robotaxi service by one hour, to 11 p.m., and that registered Cybercabs, its steering-wheel-less robotaxis, have grown to 169, with 111 added in two weeks according to Texas DMV data. Tesla is aiming for 24/7 service as early as this month, but Elon Musk said spotting animals at night is the main problem still being solved.
notes: Enthusiast outlet; fleet numbers are from Texas DMV data as read by the outlet; 24/7 is a target, not a commitment.
